hooks.name: Lint JS/CSS on save
hooks.description: Runs @wordpress/scripts lint on saved JS/CSS for instant feedback. Skips silently if dependencies are not installed yet.

action.command: cd "/Users/param/Developer/WP Multipurpose Parent Theme/wp-multipurpose-parent-theme" && if [ -d node_modules/@wordpress/scripts ]; then npm run --silent lint:js || true; npm run --silent lint:css || true; else echo "@wordpress/scripts not installed yet — run 'npm install' to enable this check."; fi
